G3587: to shave, shear, cut off the hair.
From a derivative of the same as xulon (meaning a razor); to shave or "shear" the hair.
G3588: Including the feminine he (hay), and the neuter to (to) in all their inflections; the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom).
the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.
G359: a loosing, departing, departure (from this life); (Probably a metaphor from the yoking and unyoking of transport animals).
G3590: the eighth, one of eight, with seven others.
G3591: (properly: bulk, mass, hence) a weight, burden, encumbrance.
Probably from the same as agkale; a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. Burden (hindrance).
G3592: Including the feminine hede (hay'-deh), and the neuter tode (tod'-e) from ho and de; the same, i.e. This or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun.
G3594: to lead, guide; met: to instruct, teach.
From hodegos; to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach)).
G3595: a leader, guide; met: an instructor, teacher.
From hodos and hegeomai; a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)).
G3596: to travel, pursue a way, journey.
From a compound of hodos and poreuomai; to be a wayfarer, i.e. Travel.
G3597: From the same as hodoiporeo; travel.
G3598: Apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means.
G3599: Perhaps from the base of esthio; a "tooth".
G36: lit: without family, hence: ignoble, base.
From a (as negative particle) and genos; properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble.
G360: to unloose, unloose for departure, depart, return.
From ana and luo; to break up, i.e. Depart (literally or figuratively).
G3600: to torment, pain; mid. and pass: to be tormented, pained; to suffer acute pain, physical or mental.
G3601: pain, sorrow, distress, of body or mind.
G3602: From a derivative of the base of duno; moaning, i.e. Lamentation.
G3603: From the neuter of hos and the third person singular present indicative of eimi; which is.
called, which is (make), that is (to say).
G3604: Uzziah, son of Joram and father of Jotham, and king of Judah from about 785 to 746 B.C., an ancestor of Jesus.
Of Hebrew origin (Uzziyah); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite.
G3605: A primary verb (in a strengthened form).
G3606: From hos with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction).
G3607: a linen cloth, a sheet, sail.
Of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail.
G3608: Neuter of a presumed derivative of othone; a linen bandage.
G3609: From oikos; domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent.
G361: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of hamartano; sinless.
G3610: From oikeo; a fellow resident, i.e. Menial domestic.
G3611: From oikos; to occupy a house, i.e. Reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit.
G3612: From oikeo; a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail.
G3613: Neuter of a presumed derivative of oikeo (equivalent to oikema); a residence (literally or figuratively).
G3614: a house, household, dwelling; meton: goods, property, means.
From oikos; properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics).
G3615: one of a family, whether child or servant.
From oikia; familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives.
G3616: From oikodespotes; to be the head of (i.e. Rule) a family.
G3617: From oikos and despotes; the head of a family.
goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.
G3618: to erect a building, build; fig. of the building up of character: to build up, edify, encourage.
From the same as oikodome; to be a house-builder, i.e. Construct or (figuratively) confirm.
G3619: (a) the act of building, (b) a building, (c) met: spiritual advancement, edification.
Feminine (abstract) of a compound of oikos and the base of doma; architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation.
G362: to await (one whose coming is expected).
From ana and meno; to await.
G3620: From the same as oikodome; confirmation.
G3621: to be a steward, manage a household.
From oikonomos; to manage (a house, i.e. An estate).
G3622: management of household affairs, stewardship, administration.
From oikonomos; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy".
G3623: a household manager, a steward, guardian.

From oikos and the base of nomos; a house-distributor (i.e. Manager), or overseer, i.e. An employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel).
G3624: (a) a house, the material building, (b) a household, family, lineage, nation.
Of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively).
G3625: (properly: the land that is being inhabited, the land in a state of habitation), the inhabited world, that is, the Roman world, for all outside it was regarded as of no account.
Feminine participle present passive of oikeo (as noun, by implication, of ge); land, i.e. The (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire.
G3626: From oikos and ouros (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. Domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper").
G3627: to pity, to have compassion on.
Also (in certain tenses) prolonged oiktereo oyk-ter-eh'-o from oiktos (pity); to exercise pity.
G363: to remind, admonish, be reminded, remind myself; pass: to remember, recall.
From ana and mimnesko; to remind; (reflexively) to recollect.
call to mind, (bring to, call to, put in), remember(-brance).
G3630: From oinos and a derivative of the alternate of pino; a tippler.
G3631: A primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (yayin)); "wine" (literally or figuratively).
G3632: From oinos and a form of the base of phluaros; an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. Vinolency (drunkenness).
G3633: Or (shorter) oimai (oy'-mahee) middle voice apparently from hoios; to make like (oneself), i.e. Imagine (be of the opinion).
G3634: Probably akin to ho, hos, and hosos; such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so.
so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.
G3635: to shrink (from doing), to hesitate (to do).
From oknos (hesitation); to be slow (figuratively, loath).
G3636: slothful, backward, hesitating; of things: irksome.
From okneo; tardy, i.e. Indolent; (figuratively) irksome.
G3637: of or belonging to the eighth day, eight days old.
From oktos and hemera; an eight-day old person or act.
G3639: From a primary ollumi (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. Death, punishment.
G3640: From oligos and pistis; incredulous, i.e. Lacking confidence (in Christ).
G3641: (a) especially in plur: few, (b) in sing: small; hence, of time: short, of degree: light, slight, little.

+ almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.
G3642: From oligos and pshar; little-spirited, i.e. Faint-hearted.
G3643: to despise, hold in low esteem, make light of.
From a compound of oligos and ora ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. To disesteem.
G3644: From olothreuo; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent.
G3645: From olethros; to spoil, i.e. Slay.
G3646: From a derivative of a compound of holos and a derivative of kaio; a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust").
G3647: From holokleros; integrity, i.e. Physical wholeness.
G3648: complete in every part, sound, perfect, entire.
From holos and kleros; complete in every part, i.e. Perfectly sound (in body).
G3649: to howl, lament loudly, cry aloud, bewail.
A reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e. Shriek.
G365: to renew; mid: to renew myself, be renewed.
From ana and a derivative of neos; to renovate, i.e. Reform.
G3650: A primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. Complete (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb.
all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.
G3651: From holos and telos; complete to the end, i.e. Absolutely perfect.
G3652: Olympas, a Christian man in Rome.
Probably a contraction from Olumpiodoros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. Heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian.
G3653: an unripe fig, one which, not ripening in due time, grows through the winter and falls off in the spring.
Of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig.
G3654: wholly, altogether, actually, really; with negative: not at all.
Adverb from holos; completely, i.e. Altogether; (by analogy), everywhere; (negatively) not by any means.
G3655: Of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm.
G3656: to consort with, associate with, commune with; particularly, to talk (converse) with.
From homilos; to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse.
G3657: From homilos; companionship ("homily"), i.e. (by implication) intercourse.
G3658: From the base of homou and a derivative of the alternate of haireomai (meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. A multitude.
G3659: From optanomai; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye.
G366: to return to soberness, regain one's senses.
From ana and nepho; to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses.
G3660: to swear, take an oath, promise with an oath.
A prolonged form of a primary, but obsolete omo, for which another prolonged form omoo (om-o'-o) is used in certain tenses; to swear, i.e. Take (or declare on) oath.
G3661: with one mind, unanimously, with one accord, at the same time.
Adverb from a compound of the base of homou and thumos; unanimously.
G3663: of like feelings, having similar passions and feelings, of like infirmities.
From homoios and the alternate of pascho; similarly affected.
G3664: like, similar to, resembling, of equal rank.
From the base of homou; similar (in appearance or character).
G3666: to make like, liken; to compare.
From homoios; to assimilate, i.e. Compare; passively, to become similar.
G3667: (originally: a thing made like something else), a likeness, or rather: form; a similitude.
From homoioo; a form; abstractly, resemblance.
made like to, likeness, shape, similitude.
G3668: in like manner, similarly, in the same way, equally.
G367: Ananias, (a) husband of Sapphira, a member of the early church at Jerusalem, (b) a member of the church at Damascus, (c) the high priest at Jerusalem.
Of Hebrew origin (Chananyah); Ananias, the name of three Israelites.
G3670: (a) to promise, agree, (b) to confess, (c) to publicly declare, (d) a Hebraism, to praise, celebrate.
From a compound of the base of homou and logos; to assent, i.e. Covenant, acknowledge.
con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise.

G3673: of the same trade or craft.
From the base of homou and techne; a fellow-artificer.
G3674: together, at the same place and time.
Genitive case of homos (the same; akin to hama) as adverb; at the same place or time.
G3675: From the base of homou and phren; like-minded, i.e. Harmonious.
G3676: Adverb from the base of homou; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still.
G3678: Neuter of a presumed derivative of onos; a little ass.
G3679: From oneidos; to defame, i.e. Rail at, chide, taunt.

G368: indisputable, undeniable, not to be contradicted.
From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of anti and rheo; indisputable.
G3681: Probably akin to the base of onoma; notoriety, i.e. A taunt (disgrace).
G3682: (originally adj: useful, hence the play upon words in Philemon 10, 11, and very common as slave name), Onesimus, a slave of Philemon, a Christian of Colossae.
From oninemi; profitable; Onesimus, a Christian.
G3683: Onesiphorus, a Christian of the province of Asia.
From a derivative of oninemi and phoros; profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a Christian.
G3684: From onos; belonging to a ass, i.e. Large (so as to be turned by a ass).
G3685: to profit, benefit, help; mid: to have profit, derive benefit.

G3686: From a presumed derivative of the base of ginosko (compare oninemi); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character).
G3687: to give a name to, mention, call upon the name of.
From onoma; to name, i.e. Assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess.
G3688: Apparently a primary word; a donkey.
G3689: Adverb of the oblique cases of on; really.
certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily.
G3690: vinegar, sour wine mixed with water, a common drink of Roman soldiers.
From oxus; vinegar, i.e. Sour wine.
G3691: Probably akin to the base of akmen ("acid"); keen; by analogy, rapid.
G3692: a crevice (in a rock), a cave, an opening, hole.
Probably from optanomai; a hole (as if for light), i.e. Cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water).
G3693: From opis (regard; from optanomai) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. At the back (adverb and preposition of place or time).

G3695: From hoplon; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)).
G3696: Probably from a primary hepo (to be busy about); an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war).
G3697: of what kind or manner, of what sort.
From hos and poios; of what kind that, i.e. How (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent toioutos of quality).

G3699: From hos and pou; what(-ever) where, i.e. At whichever spot.

G37: to make holy, treat as holy, set apart as holy, sanctify, hallow, purify.
From hagios; to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate.
G370: From a (as a negative particle) and axios; unfit.
G3700: to appear, be seen (by), let myself be seen (by).

G3701: From a presumed derivative of optanomai; visuality, i.e. (concretely) an apparition.
G3702: From an obsolete verb akin to hepso (to "steep"); cooked, i.e. Roasted.
G3703: Apparently from the base of opse and hora; properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit.
G3704: how, in order that, so that, that.
From hos and pos; what(-ever) how, i.e. In the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual).
G3705: a spectacle, vision, that which is seen.
From horao; something gazed at, i.e. A spectacle (especially supernatural).
G3706: the act of seeing, a vision, appearance.
From horao; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance.
G3707: From horao; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen.
G3708: to see, look upon, experience, perceive, discern, beware.

G3712: a fathom (the length of the outstretched arms).
From oregomai; a stretch of the arms, i.e. A fathom.
G3713: to stretch forth, mid: to hanker after, long for, be eager for, aspire to.
Middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare oros); to stretch oneself, i.e. Reach out after (long for).

G3715: From oregomai; excitement of the mind, i.e. Longing after.
G3716: to walk in a straight course, walk uprightly.
From a compound of orthos and pous; to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward.
G3717: Probably from the base of oros; right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct.
G3718: to cut straight; met: to handle correctly, teach rightly.
From a compound of orthos and the base of tomoteros, to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message).
G3719: to rise early, come in the morning.
From orthros; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes.
G372: From anapano; intermission; by implication, recreation.
G3720: From orthros; relating to the dawn, i.e. Matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day).
G3721: From orthros; in the dawn, i.e. Up at day-break.
G3722: From the same as oros; dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn.
G3723: Adverb from orthos; in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally).
G3724: to separate, mark off by boundaries; to determine, appoint, designate.
From horion; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify.
G3725: the boundaries of a place, hence: districts, territory.
Neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary horos (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region).
G3726: to adjure by, charge solemnly by.
From horkos; to put on oath, i.e. Make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin.
G3727: From herkos (a fence; perhaps akin to horion); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath).
G3728: the taking of an oath, an oath.
From a compound of horkos and a derivative of omnuo; asseveration on oath.
G3729: to set in motion, to hasten on.
From horme; to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge.
G373: to give rest, give intermission from labor, by implication refresh.
From ana and pauo; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh.
G3730: a rapid motion forwards, onrush, assault.
Of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. Onset.
G3731: From horme; an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy.
G3732: Neuter of a presumed derivative of ornis; a birdling.
G3733: a bird, a rooster or hen.
Probably from a prolonged form of the base of oros; a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl).
G3734: a setting of boundaries, definite limit; plur: bounds.
From a compound of the base of horion and a derivative of tithemi; a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line.
G3735: Probably from an obsolete oro (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to airo; compare ornis); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain): -hill, mount(-ain)..

G3737: Of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. Parentless.

G3739: usually rel. who, which, that, also demonstrative this, that.

one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc. See also hou.
G374: From ana and peitho; to incite.
G3740: as often as, as many times as.
Multiple adverb from hos; how (i.e. With an, so) many times as.
G3741: holy, pious, godly, beloved of God.

all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while,…

G3747: Or contracted ostoun (os-toon') of uncertain affinity; a bone.

G3750: From a derivative of ozo; smell (the sense).
G3751: Of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. The hip; internally (by extension) procreative power.

Genitive case of hos as adverb; at which place, i.e. Where.

G3768: From ou and po; not yet.
hitherto not, (no...) As yet, not yet.
G3769: Apparently a primary word; a tail.
G377: to lie down, recline (at a dinner-table), fall back upon (the breast of another person reclining at dinner).
From ana and pipto; to fall back, i.e. Lie down, lean back.
G3770: in heaven, belonging to heaven, heavenly, from heaven.
From ouranos; celestial, i.e. Belonging to or coming from the sky.
G3771: From ouranos and the enclitic of source; from the sky.
G3772: heaven, (a) the visible heavens: the atmosphere, the sky, the starry heavens, (b) the spiritual heavens.
Perhaps from the same as oros (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity).
G3773: Urbanus, a Christian in Rome, fellow-worker of Paul.
Of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian.
G3774: Uriah, husband of Bathsheba the mother of Solomon.
Of Hebrew origin ('Uwriyah); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite.
G3775: (a) the ear, (b) met: the faculty of perception.
Apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally).
G3776: From the feminine of on; substance, i.e. Property (possessions).
G3777: From ou and te; not too, i.e. Neither or nor; by analogy, not even.
neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing.
G3778: Including nominative masculine plural houtoi (hoo'-toy), nominative feminine singular haute (how'-tay), and nominative feminine plural hautai (how'-tahee) from the article ho and autos; the he (she or it), i.e. This or that (often with article repeated).
he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who.
G3779: Or (before a vowel houtos hoo'-toce adverb from houtos; in this way (referring to what precedes or follows).
after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what.
G378: to fill up, make up, complete the measure of, fulfill, carry out the commands (provisions, etc.) of.
From ana and pleroo; to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience).
G3780: by no means, not at all.
G3781: (a) a debtor, one who owes, one who is indebted, (b) one who has sinned against another (an Aramaism), a sinner.
From opheilo; an ower, i.e. Person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God).
G3782: a debt, a duty, what is due.
From opheilo; indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty.
G3783: that which is owed, a debt.
From (the alternate of) opheilo; something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault.
G3784: Or (in certain tenses), its prolonged form opheileo (of-i-leh'-o) probably from the base of ophelos (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty.
behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should. See also ophelon.
G3785: O that! I wish! Would that!, followed by indicative.
First person singular of a past tense of opheilo; I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!.
G3786: From ophello (to heap up, i.e. Accumulate or benefit); gain.
G3787: eye-service; service rendered only while the master watches.
From ophthalmos and douleia; sight-labor, i.e. That needs watching (remissness).
G3788: the eye; fig: the mind's eye.
From optanomai; the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance).
G3789: a serpent, snake; used of the devil or Satan.
Probably from optanomai (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan.
G379: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of apologeomai; indefensible.
G3790: the brow, a ridge (of a mountain).
Perhaps from optanomai (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice.
G3791: From ochlos; to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass.
G3792: to gather a crowd, make a riot.
From ochlos and poieo; to make a crowd, i.e. Raise a public disturbance.
G3793: a crowd, multitude, the common people.
From a derivative of echo (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot.
company, multitude, number (of people), people, press.
G3794: From a remote derivative of echo (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument).
G3795: Neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of optos; a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment).
G3796: From the same as opiso (through the idea of backwardness); (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day.
G3798: From opse; late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve).
G3799: (a) the face, countenance, (b) the features, outward appearance.
From optanomai; properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show.
G38: the process of making or becoming holy, set apart, sanctification, holiness, consecration.
From hagiazo; properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier.
G380: From ana (in the sense of reversal) and ptusso; to unroll (a scroll or volume).
G3800: Neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as opsarion; rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay.
G3801: ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
ho ón kai ho én kai ho erchomenos

Ho erchomenos (ho own kahee) ho ane kahee (ho er-khom'-en-os) a phrase combining ho with the present participle and imperfect of eimi and the present participle of erchomai by means of kai; the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e. The…
which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be).
G3803: a snare, trap (especially for catching birds) hence, met: stratagem, device, wile.
From pegnumi; a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation).
G3804: (a) suffering, affliction, (b) passion, emotion, (c) an undergoing, an enduring.
From a presumed derivative of pathos; something undergone, i.e. Hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence.
G3805: one who has suffered or is subject to suffering.
From the same as pathema; liable (i.e. Doomed) to experience pain.
G3806: that which befalls one, a passion, a suffering.
From the alternate of pascho; properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence).
G3807: a boy's guardian or tutor, a slave who had charge of the life and morals of the boys of a family, not strictly a teacher.
From pais and a reduplicated form of ago; a boy-leader, i.e. A servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("paedagogue")).
G3808: Neuter of a presumed derivative of pais; a little boy.
G3809: discipline; training and education of children, hence: instruction; chastisement, correction.
From paideuo; tutorage, i.e. Education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction.
G381: to kindle, set on fire, light.
From ana and hapto; to enkindle.
G3810: an instructor, trainer; almost: a chastiser.
From paideuo; a trainer, i.e. Teacher or (by implication) discipliner.
G3811: (a) to discipline, educate, train, (b) more severely: to chastise.
From pais; to train up a child, i.e. Educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment).
G3812: Adverb (of source) from paidion; from infancy.
G3813: a little child, an infant, little one.
Neuter diminutive of pais; a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian.
G3814: a female slave, maidservant, maid, young girl.
Feminine diminutive of pais; a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant.
G3815: to play, sport (includes singing and dancing), play in the manner of children.
From pais; to sport (as a boy).
G3816: (a) a male child, boy, (b) a male slave, servant; thus: a servant of God, especially as a title of the Messiah, (c) a female child, girl.

Perhaps from paio; a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God).
child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man.
G3817: A primary verb; to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than tupto); specially, to sting (as a scorpion).
G3818: Feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia.
G3819: of old, long ago, in times past, former.
Probably another form for palin (through the idea of retrocession); (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient.
any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past.
G382: uncountable, innumerable, that cannot be numbered.
From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of arithmeo; unnumbered, i.e. Without number.
G3820: old, ancient, not new or recent.
From palai; antique, i.e. Not recent, worn out.
G3822: to make old, declare obsolete; pass: to grow old, become obsolete.
From palaios; to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete.
G3823: wrestling, a wrestling bout; hence: a struggle, fight, conflict, contest.
From pallo (to vibrate; another form for ballo); wrestling.
G3824: From palin and genesis; (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration.
G3825: again, back, once more, further, on the other hand.
Probably from the same as pale (through the idea of oscillatory repetition); (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand.
G3826: Dative case (adverb) of a compound of pas and plethos; in full multitude, i.e. Concertedly or simultaneously.
G3827: From pas and polus; full many, i.e. Immense.
G3828: Pamphylia, a Roman province on the south coast of Asia Minor.
From a compound of pas and pura; every-tribal, i.e. Heterogeneous (chora being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor.
G3829: Neuter of a presumed compound of pas and a derivative of dechomai; all-receptive, i.e. A public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan).
G383: to shake up, stir up, excite.
From ana and seio; figuratively, to excite.
G3830: From the same as pandocheion; an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai).
G3831: From pas and a derivative of agora; a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively) universal companionship.
G3832: with one's whole household or family.
Adverb from pas and oikos; with the whole family.
G3833: From a compound of pas and hoplon; full armor ("panoply").
G3834: From panougos; adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry.
G3835: ready to do anything, crafty, skillful.
From pas and ergon; all-working, i.e. Adroit (shrewd).
G3836: from all sides, from all parts.
Adverb (of source) from pantachou; from all directions.
G3837: Genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of pas; universally.
G3838: complete, entire, perfect, through all time.
From pas and telos; full-ended, i.e. Entire (neuter as noun, completion).
G384: to pervert, subvert, dismantle, unsettle, overthrow, destroy.
From ana (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of skeuos; properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset.
G3840: from all sides, on all sides.
Adverb (of source) from pas; from (i.e. On) all sides.
G3841: ruler of all, ruler of the universe, the almighty.
From pas and kratos; the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign).
G3842: From pas and hote; every when, i.e. At all times.
G3843: wholly, entirely, in every way, by all means, certainly.
Adverb from pas; entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event.
by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely.
G3844: gen: from; dat: beside, in the presence of; acc: alongside of.

A primary preposition; properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or…
above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side...by, in the sight of,…
G3845: From para and the base of basis; to go contrary to, i.e. Violate a command.
G3846: From para and ballo; to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken.
G3849: to urge, press, constrain by entreaties.
From para and the middle voice of biazo; to force contrary to (nature), i.e. Compel (by entreaty).
G385: to drag up, pull up, draw up, draw out.
From ana and spao; to take up or extricate.
G3850: (a) a comparison, (b) a parable, often of those uttered by our Lord, (c) a proverb, an adage.
From paraballo; a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage.
G3851: to expose myself to danger; to be adventuresome, reckless.
From para and the middle voice of bouleuo; to misconsult, i.e. Disregard.
G3852: a command, charge, injunction; a precept, rule of living.
G3853: to notify, command, charge, entreat solemnly.
From para and the base of aggelos; to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin.
G3854: (a) to come on the scene, appear, come, (b) with words expressing destination: to present myself at, arrive at, reach.
From para and ginomai; to become near, i.e. Approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly.
G3855: to lead by, to pass by or away.
From para and ago; to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away.
G3856: to put to open shame, make a public example of, put to disgrace.
From para and deigmatizo; to show alongside (the public), i.e. Expose to infamy.
make a public example, put to an open shame.
G3857: a park, a garden, a paradise.
Of Oriental origin (compare pardec); a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise").
G3858: From para and dechomai; to accept near, i.e. Admit or (by implication) delight in.
G3859: From a compound of para and diatribo; misemployment, i.e. Meddlesomeness.
G386: a standing up, a resurrection, a raising up, rising.
From anistemi; a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth).
raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.
G3860: to hand over, pledge, hand down, deliver, commit, commend, betray, abandon.
From para and didomi; to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit.
betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend.
G3861: From para and doxa (in the sense of seeming); contrary to expectation, i.e. Extraordinary ("paradox").
G3862: a handing down or over, a tradition.
From paradidomi; transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law.
G3863: to make jealous, provoke to jealously, provoke to anger.
From para and zeloo; to stimulate alongside, i.e. Excite to rivalry.
G3864: From para and thalassa; along the sea, i.e. Maritime (lacustrine).
G3865: From para and theoreo; to overlook or disregard.
G3866: a deposit, anything committed to one's charge or trust.
From paratithemi; a deposit, i.e. (figuratively) trust.
G3867: From para and aineo; to mispraise, i.e. Recommend or advise (a different course).
G3868: to beg off, make excuse, deprecate, refuse, reject, decline, shun, avoid.
From para and the middle voice of aiteo; to beg off, i.e. Deprecate, decline, shun.
G3869: to sit down beside, set beside.
From para and kathizo; to sit down near.
G387: (perhaps a political metaphor), to turn upside down, upset, unsettle.
From a derivative of anistemi (in the sense of removal); properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively).
trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.
G3870: (a) to send for, summon, invite, (b) to beseech, entreat, beg, (c) to exhort, admonish, (d) to comfort, encourage, console.
From para and kaleo; to call near, i.e. Invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation).
beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray.
G3871: to cover (by hanging something beside), to hide.
From para and kalupto; to cover alongside, i.e. Veil (figuratively).
G3872: From a compound of para and katatithemi; something put down alongside, i.e. A deposit (sacred trust).
G3873: to be at hand, be present with, rest with.
From para and keimai; to lie near, i.e. Be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy).
G3874: a calling for, summons, hence: (a) exhortation, (b) entreaty, (c) encouragement, joy, gladness, (d) consolation, comfort.
G3875: (a) an advocate, intercessor, (b) a consoler, comforter, helper, (c) Paraclete.
G3876: a hearing amiss, by implication disobedience.
From parakouo; inattention, i.e. (by implication) disobedience.
G3877: to accompany, follow closely, characterize, both lit. and met.; to investigate.
From para and akoloutheo; to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to.
attain, follow, fully know, have understanding.
G3878: (a) to hear carelessly or incidentally, or to pretend not to hear, (b) to refuse to hear; to disobey, disregard.
From para and akouo; to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey.
G3879: to stoop, peer in, look down, look intently.
From para and kupto; to bend beside, i.e. Lean over (so as to peer within).
G388: From ana and stauroo; to recrucify (figuratively).
G3880: to take from, receive from, or: to take to, receive (apparently not used of money), admit, acknowledge; to take with me.
From para and lambano; to receive near, i.e. Associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn.
G3881: to sail past or coast along.
From para and the middle voice of lego (in its original sense); (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. Sail past.
G3882: adjacent to the sea, on the coast.
From para and hals; beside the salt (sea), i.e. Maritime.
G3883: From a compound of para and allasso.
transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness; variableness.
G3884: to deceive, beguile, reason falsely, mislead.
From para and logizomai; to misreckon, i.e. Delude.
G3885: From a derivative of paraluo; as if dissolved, i.e. "paralytic".
G3886: From para and luo; to loosen beside, i.e. Relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled).
feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy.
G3887: to remain by, abide with; met: to persevere in.
From para and meno; to stay near, i.e. Remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere).
G3888: From para and the middle voice of a derivative of muthos; to relate near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console.
G389: From ana and stenazo; to sigh deeply.
G3890: comfort, consolation, an exhortation, persuasion, encouragement.
G3891: From a compound of para and nomos; to be opposed to law, i.e. To transgress.
G3893: From para and pikraino; to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate.
G3895: to fall away, fall back (into the unbelieving and godless ways of the old time).
From para and pipto; to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize.
G3896: From para and pleo; to sail near.
G3897: Neuter of a compound of para and the base of plesion (as adverb); close by, i.e. (figuratively) almost.
G3898: Adverb from the same as paraplesion; in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly.
G3899: to go past, pass by, pass along by.
From para and poreuomai; to travel near.
G39: Neuter of hagios; a sacred thing (i.e. Spot).
G390: to overturn; to turn back, return; to turn hither and thither; pass: to turn myself about; to sojourn, dwell; to conduct myself, behave, live.
From ana and strepho; to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. Remain, live.
abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.
G3900: a falling away, lapse, slip, false step, trespass, sin.
From parapipto; a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression.
G3901: (lit: to flow past, glide past, hence) to be lost, perish, or merely: to drift away (fall away) from duty.
From para and the alternate of rheo; to flow by, i.e. (figuratively) carelessly pass (miss).
G3902: marked amiss, marked at the side, marked with a sign.
From para and the base of semaino; side-marked, i.e. Labelled (with a badge (figure-head) of a ship).
G3903: to prepare; mid: to prepare, make preparations.
From para and a derivative of skeuos; to furnish aside, i.e. Get ready.
G3904: preparation, the day of preparation (for a Sabbath or feast).
G3905: From para and teino (to stretch); to extend along, i.e. Prolong (in point of time).
G3906: to watch closely, to observe scrupulously.
From para and tereo; to inspect alongside, i.e. Note insidiously or scrupulously.
G3907: From paratereo; inspection, i.e. Ocular evidence.
G3908: (a) to set (especially a meal) before, serve, (b) act. and mid: to deposit with, entrust to, (c) to bring forward, quote as evidence.
From para and tithemi; to place alongside, i.e. Present (food, truth); by implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection).
allege, commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before.
G3909: to come by chance, chance to meet.
From para and tugchano; to chance near, i.e. Fall in with.
G391: dealing with other men, conduct, life, behavior, manner of life.
G3910: adv. with force of adj: present, immediate, for the moment.
From para and a derivative of autos; at the very instant, i.e. Momentary.
G3911: to turn aside, carry away, remove, cause to pass away; pass: to be misled, seduced.
From para and phero (including its alternate forms); to bear along or aside, i.e. Carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to avert.
G3912: to be out of senses, be beside myself.
From para and phroneo; to misthink, i.e. Be insane (silly).
G3914: From para and cheimazo; to winter near, i.e. Stay with over the rainy season.
G3916: From para and chrema (in its original sense); at the thing itself, i.e. Instantly.
G3917: Feminine of pardos (a panther); a leopard.
G3918: to be present, be near; to have come, arrived.
From para and eimi (including its various forms); to be near, i.e. At hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural) property.
come, X have, be here, + lack, (be here) present.
G3919: to introduce, to bring in secretly.
From para and eisago; to lead in aside, i.e. Introduce surreptitiously.
G392: to arrange, draw up, compose, but perhaps: to set down from memory, restore from memory.
From ana and the middle voice of tasso; to arrange.
G3921: to enter secretly, come in by stealth.
From para and a compound of eis and duno; to settle in alongside, i.e. Lodge stealthily.
G3922: to enter secretly, come in from the side.
From para and eiserchomai; to come in alongside, i.e. Supervene additionally or steathily.
G3923: to contribute besides, bring in besides, smuggle in.
From para and eisphero; to bear in alongside, i.e. Introduce simultaneously.
G3924: (a) adv. used as adj: besides, outside, without, left over, in addition, (b) prep: apart from, except.
From para and ektos; near outside, i.e. Besides.
G3925: a camp, fort, castle, barracks, army in battle array.
From a compound of para and emballo; a throwing in beside (juxtaposition), i.e. (specially), battle-array, encampment or barracks (tower Antonia).
G3926: to trouble, cause disturbance to, annoy, harass.
From para and enochleo; to harass further, i.e. Annoy.
G3927: residing in a strange country; subst: a stranger, sojourner.
From para and the base of epidemeo; an alien alongside, i.e. A resident foreigner.
G3928: to pass by, pass away, pass out of sight; to be rendered void, become vain, neglect, disregard.
From para and erchomai; to come near or aside, i.e. To approach (arrive), go by (or away), (figuratively) perish or neglect, (causative) avert.
come (forth), go, pass (away, by, over), past, transgress.
G3929: overlooking, suspension, remission of punishment for.
G393: to make to rise, to rise, shine (generally of the sun, and hence met.).
From ana and the base of telos; to (cause to) arise.
(a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.
G3930: act. and mid: to offer, provide, confer, afford, give, bring, show, cause.
From para and echo; to hold near, i.e. Present, afford, exhibit, furnish occasion.
bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, + trouble.
G3931: From a compound of para and a derivative of agora (meaning to harangue an assembly); an address alongside, i.e. (specially), consolation.
G3933: a maiden, virgin; extended to men who have not known women.

Feminine of planos (as abstractly); objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety.
G4107: From planos; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic teacher.
G4108: adj: misleading, deceiving, wandering; as subst: a deceiver, imposter.
Of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an impostor or misleader.
G4109: anything flat and broad, a flat stone.
From plasso; a moulding-board, i.e. Flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively).
G411: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related, inexpressible.
From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ekdiegeomai; not expounded in full, i.e. Indescribable.
G4111: to form, mould, as a potter his clay.
A primary verb; to mould, i.e. Shape or fabricate.
G4112: formed, molded; fig: feigned, made up, counterfeit.
From plasso; moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false).
G4113: a street, public square, broad way.
Feminine of platus; a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. Open square.
G4115: to enlarge, make broad; met: of the growth of tenderness and love.
From platus; to widen (literally or figuratively).
G4116: From plasso; spread out "flat" ("plot"), i.e. Broad.
G4118: the greatest, the most, very great.
Irregular superlative of polus; the largest number or very large.
G4119: Or neuter pleion (pli'-on), or pleon (pleh'-on) comparative of polus; more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion.
X above, + exceed, more excellent, further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but.
G412: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of eklaleo; not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable.
G4120: to weave together, plait, twist, braid.
A primary word; to twine or braid.
G4121: to have more than enough; to abound, increase.
From pleion; to do, make or be more, i.e. Increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound.
abound, abundant, make to increase, have over.
G4122: to take advantage of, overreach, defraud.
From pleonektes; to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach.
get an advantage, defraud, make a gain.
G4123: a covetous or avaricious person; one desirous of having more.
From pleion and echo; holding (desiring) more, i.e. Eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder).
G4124: covetousness, avarice, aggression, desire for advantage.
From pleonektes; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency, extortion.
G4125: Of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side.
G4126: to sail, travel by sea, voyage.
Another form for pleuo (plyoo'-o); which is used as an alternate in certain tenses; probably a form of pluno (through the idea of plunging through the water); to pass in a vessel.
G4127: a blow, stripe, wound; an affliction, plague.
From plesso; a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity.
G4128: a multitude, crowd, great number, assemblage.
From pletho; a fulness, i.e. A large number, throng, populace.
G4129: From another form of plethos; to increase (transitively or intransitively).
G413: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ekleipo; not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible.
G4130: A prolonged form of a primary pleo (pleh'-o) (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form pimplemi) to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time).
G4131: From plesso; a smiter, i.e. Pugnacious (quarrelsome).
G4132: Prolonged from pletho; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet.
G4133: however, nevertheless, but, except that, yet.
From pleion; moreover (besides), i.e. Albeit, save that, rather, yet.
but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.
G4134: full, abounding in, complete, completely occupied with.
From pletho; replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete.
G4135: (lit: to carry full), (a) to complete, carry out fully, (b) to fully convince, satisfy fully, (c) to fully believe.
From pleres and phoreo; to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. Completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish.
most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of.
G4137: From pleres; to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc..
accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply.
G4138: (a) a fill, fullness; full complement; supply, patch, supplement, (b) fullness, filling, fulfillment, completion.
From pleroo; repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period).
which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.
G4139: Neuter of a derivative of pelas (near); (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e. Fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or friend).
G414: Comparative of a derivative of anechomai; more endurable.
G4140: From a presumed derivative of pletho; a filling up, i.e. (figuratively) gratification.
G4141: Apparently another form of plasso (through the idea of flattening out); to pound, i.e. (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity).
G4142: Neuter of a presumed derivative of ploion; a boat.
G4143: From pleo; a sailer, i.e. Vessel.
G4144: From pleo; a sail, i.e. Navigation.
G4145: rich, abounding in, wealthy; subst: a rich man.
From ploutos; wealthy; figuratively, abounding with.
G4147: to become rich, be rich, abound in.
From ploutizo; to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively).
be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.
G4148: to make rich, cause to abound in, enrich.
G4149: riches, wealth, abundance, materially or spiritually.
From the base of pletho; wealth (as fulness), i.e. (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment.
G415: From a (as a negative particle) and eleemon; merciless.
G4150: A prolonged form of an obsolete pluo (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e. Launder clothing.
G4151: From pneo; a current of air, i.e. Breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit,…
ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind. Compare psuche.
G4152: From pneuma; non-carnal, i.e. (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (daemoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious.
G4153: spiritually, in a spiritual way; from a spiritual point of view.
Adverb from pneumatikos; non-physically, i.e. Divinely, figuratively.
G4154: to blow, breathe, as the wind.
A primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. Breeze.
G4155: to choke, throttle, strangle; hence: to drown.
Strengthened from pneo; to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown).
G4156: strangled (i.e. killed without letting out the blood).
From pnigo; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled).
G4158: reaching to the feet (of a garment).
From pous and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress (esthes implied) reaching the ankles.
G4159: From the base of posis with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause.
G416: to be blown with the wind (referring to the gentler motions of the air).
From anemos; to toss with the wind.
G4160: (a) to make, manufacture, construct, (b) to do, act, cause.
Apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct).
abide, + agree, appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise,…
G4161: a thing made, a work, workmanship.
From poieo; a product, i.e. Fabric (literally or figuratively).
G4162: From poieo; action, i.e. Performance (of the law).
G4163: (a) a maker, poet, (b) a doer, carrier out, performer.
From poieo; a performer; specially, a "poet".
G4164: various, of different colors, diverse, various.
Of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. Various in character.
G4165: to shepherd, tend, herd; hence: to rule, govern.
From poimen; to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser).
G4166: a shepherd; hence met: of the feeder, protector, and ruler of a flock of men.
Of uncertain affinity; a shepherd (literally or figuratively).
G4167: Contraction from poimaino; a flock (literally or figuratively).
G4168: Neuter of a presumed derivative of poimne; a flock, i.e. (figuratively) group (of believers).
G4169: From the base of pou and hoios; individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one.
G417: the wind; fig: applied to empty doctrines.
From the base of aer; wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth).
G4170: to make war, contend, fight, battle.
to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. To battle (literally or figuratively); fight, (make) war.
G4171: From pelomai (to bustle); warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series).
G4172: a city, the inhabitants of a city.
Probably from the same as polemos, or perhaps from polus; a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size).
G4173: a ruler of a city, city magistrate.
From polis and archo; a town-officer, i.e. Magistrate.
G4174: (a) commonwealth, polity; citizen body, (b) (the Roman) citizenship, citizen-rights, franchise.
From polites ("polity"); citizenship; concretely, a community.
G4175: From politeuomai; a community, i.e. (abstractly) citizenship (figuratively).
G4176: to live the life of a citizen, live.
Middle voice of a derivative of polites; to behave as a citizen (figuratively).
G4178: Multiplicative adverb from polus; many times, i.e. Frequently.
G4179: From polus and probably a derivative of pleko; manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more.
G418: From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as endechetai; unadmitted, i.e. (by implication) not supposable.
G4180: From a compound of polus and logos; loquacity, i.e. Prolixity.
G4181: in many parts (one at one time, another at another, and so on).
Adverb from a compound of polus and meros; in many portions, i.e. Variously as to time and agency (piecemeal).
G4182: From polus and poikilos; much variegated, i.e. Multifarious.
G4183: Including the forms from the alternate pollos; (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely.
abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft(-en (-times)), plenteous, sore, straitly. Compare pleistos, pleion.
G4184: From polus and splagchnon (figuratively); extremely compassionate.
G4185: very costly, very precious, of great value.
From polus and telos; extremely expensive.
costly, very precious, of great price.
G4186: of great value, very costly, very precious.
From polus and time; extremely valuable.
G4187: Adverb from a compound of polus and tropos; in many ways, i.e. Variously as to method or form.
G4188: From the alternate of pino; a beverage.
G4189: From poneros; depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins.
G419: that cannot be searched into, inscrutable, unfathomable.
From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of exereunao; not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable.
G4190: From a derivative of ponos; hurtful, i.e. Evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from kakos, which refers rather to essential character, as well as from sapros, which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous;…
bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness). See also poneroteros.
G4192: (a) labor, toil, (b) pain, anguish, distress, suffering.
From the base of penes; toil, i.e. (by implication) anguish.
G4193: From Pontos; a Pontican, i.e. Native of Pontus.
G4194: Of Latin origin; apparently bridged; Pontius, a Roman.
G4195: Pontus, a Roman province in the north of Asia Minor, bordering on the Black Sea, governed along with Bithynia.
A sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor.
G4196: Of Latin origin; apparently "popular"; Poplius (i.e. Publius), a Roman.
G4197: From poreuomai; travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e. Career.
G4198: Middle voice from a derivative of the same as peira; to traverse, i.e. Travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.).
depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.
G4199: to lay waste, destroy, ravage, harass.
Prolongation from pertho (to sack); to ravage (figuratively).
G42: From hagios; sacredness (i.e. Properly, the quality).
G420: enduring evil, patient of evil, patiently forbearing.
From anechomai and kakos; enduring of ill, i.e. Forbearing.
G4200: a providing, a means of gain.
From a derivative of poros (a way, i.e. Means); furnishing (procuring), i.e. (by implication) money-getting (acquisition).
G4201: Porcius, the middle (gentile) name of the procurator Festus.
Of Latin origin; apparently swinish; Porcius, a Roman.
G4202: From porneuo; harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry.
G4203: to fornicate; met: to practice idolatry.
From porne; to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry.
G4204: a prostitute; met: an idolatrous community.
Feminine of pornos; a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater.
G4205: a fornicator, man who prostitutes himself.
From pernemi (to sell; akin to the base of piprasko); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine).
G4206: far, far off, at a distance.
Adverb from pro; forwards, i.e. At a distance.
far, a great way off. See also porrhothen.
G4207: from afar, far off, from a distance.
From porrho with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. Distantly.
G4208: Adverb comparative of porrho; further, i.e. A greater distance.
G4209: a purple garment, indicating power or wealth.
Of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it.
G421: From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ek and a derivative of ichnos; not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable.
G4210: From porphura; purpureal, i.e. Bluish red.
G4211: a female seller of purple cloth.
Feminine of a compound of porphura and poleo; a female trader in purple cloth.
G4212: Multiplicative from posos; how many times.
G4213: From the alternate of pino; a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught.
G4214: how much, how great, how many.
From an absolute pos (who, what) and hos; interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many).
G4215: Probably from a derivative of the alternate of pino (compare potos); a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. Running water.
G4216: From potamos and a derivative of phoreo; river-borne, i.e. Overwhelmed by a stream.
G4217: of what kind, of what manner.
Apparently from pote and the base of pou; interrogatively, whatever, i.e. Of what possible sort.
G4218: at one time or other, at some time, formerly.
From the base of pou and te; indefinite adverb, at some time, ever.
afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n-)ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when.
G4219: From the base of pou and te; interrogative adverb, at what time.
G422: having no cause to be ashamed.
From a (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of epi and aischunomai; not ashamed, i.e. Irreprehensible.
that needeth not to be ashamed.
G4220: Neuter of a comparative of the base of pou; interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. Is it this or that.
G4221: a drinking cup, the contents of the cup; fig: the portion which God allots.
Neuter of a derivative of the alternate of pino; a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. A cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate.
G4222: to cause to drink, give to drink; irrigate, water.
From a derivative of the alternate of pino; to furnish drink, irrigate.
G4223: Puteoli, the great harbor for traffic with Alexandria on the Bay of Naples.
Of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. Mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy.
G4224: From the alternate of pino; a drinking-bout or carousal.
G4225: where, somewhere, anywhere; with numerals: somewhere about.
Genitive case of an indefinite pronoun pos (some) otherwise obsolete (compare posos); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. Nearly.
G4226: Genitive case of an interrogative pronoun pos (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as pou used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality.
G4227: Pudens, a Christian man in Rome.
Of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian.
G4228: A primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally).
G4229: a thing done, a deed, action; a matter, an affair.
From prasso; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material).
G423: From a (as a negative particle) and a derivative of epilambanomai; not arrested, i.e. (by implication) inculpable.
G4230: a business, an occupation, affair, transaction.
From pragmateuomai; a transaction, i.e. Negotiation.
G4231: From pragma; to busy oneself with, i.e. To trade.
G4232: the palace at Jerusalem occupied by the Roman governor, or the quarters of the praetorian guard in Rome.
Of Latin origin; the praetorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp).
G4233: an officer employed to execute judicial sentences.
From a derivative of prasso; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector.
G4234: (a) a doing, action, mode of action; plur: deeds, acts, (b) function, business.
From prasso; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function.
G4235: A form of praus, used in certain parts; gentle, i.e. Humble.
G4236: From praios; gentleness, by implication, humility.
G4237: a company formed into divisions (like garden-beds).
Perhaps from prason (a leek, and so an onion-patch); a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement).
G4238: to do, perform, accomplish; be in any condition, i.e. to fare; to exact, require.

A primary verb; to "practise", i.e. Perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from poieo, which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally).
commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts.
G4239: Apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble.
G424: to come up, go up, ascend.
From ana and erchomai; to ascend.
G4240: From praus; mildness, i.e. (by implication) humility.
G4241: it becomes, is fitting to, is right.
Apparently a primary verb; to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right).
G4242: From presbeuo; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors).
G4243: to be the elder, to take precedence.
From the base of presbuteros; to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher).
G4244: an assembly of elders, the Sanhedrin, officers of the church assembly, presbytery.
Neuter of a presumed derivative of presbuteros; the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery".
G4245: elder, usually used as subst.; an elder, a member of the Sanhedrin, an elder of a Christian assembly.
Comparative of presbus (elderly); older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter".
G4246: From the same as presbuteros; an old man.
G4247: Feminine of presbutes; an old woman.
G4248: From pro; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. Head foremost.
G4249: A strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw); to saw in two.
G4251: Prisca, Priscilla, the former being the more correct and formal name, the latter a diminutive and more familiar; a Roman lady, probably of good birth, wife of the Jewish Christian Aquila.
Of Latin origin; feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian woman.
G4252: Prisca, Priscilla, the former being the more correct and formal name, the latter a diminutive and more familiar; a Roman lady, probably of good birth, wife of the Jewish Christian Aquila.
Diminutive of Priska; Priscilla (i.e. Little Prisca), a Christian woman.
G4253: (a) of place: before, in front of, (b) of time: before, earlier than.
A primary preposition; "fore", i.e. In front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to.
above, ago, before, or ever. In the comparative, it retains the same significations.
G4254: (a) trans: to lead forth; in the judicial sense, into court, (b) intrans. and trans: to precede, go before, (c) intrans: to go too far.
From pro and ago; to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous)).
G4255: to propose; mid: to propose to myself, purpose.
From pro and haireomai; to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend).
G4256: From pro and a derivative of aitia; to accuse already, i.e. Previously charge.
G4257: From pro and akouo; to hear already,i.e. Anticipate.
G4258: From pro and hamartano; to sin previously (to conversion).
G4259: a porch, court before a building, vestibule.
Neuter of a presumed compound of pro and aule; a forecourt, i.e. Vestibule (alley-way).
G426: to examine (a person on trial, a witness) judicially (frequently by the aid of torture).
From ana and etazo (to test); to investigate (judicially).
G4260: From pro and the base of basis; to walk forward, i.e. Advance (literally, or in years).
+ be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken.
G4261: to thrust forward, put forth (as of branches), produce.
From pro and ballo; to throw forward, i.e. Push to the front, germinate.
G4262: From probaton; relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem.
G4263: Probably neuter of a presumed derivative of probaino; something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively).
G4264: to lead forward, lead on; met: to induce, incite, urge.
From pro and a reduplicated form of biazo; to force forward, i.e. Bring to the front, instigate.
G4265: From pro and blepo; to look out beforehand, i.e. Furnish in advance.
G4266: From pro and ginomai; to be already, i.e. Have previousy transpired.
G4267: From pro and ginosko; to know beforehand, i.e. Foresee.
G427: without, without the cooperation (or knowledge) of.
G4270: (a) to write previously (aforetime); to write above (already), (b) to depict or portray openly, (c) to designate beforehand.
From pro and grapho; to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe.
before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime).
G4271: manifest to all, evident, very clear.
From pro and delos; plain before all men, i.e. Obvious.
G4272: to give before, give forth, betray.
From pro and didomi; to give before the other party has given.
G4273: From prodidomi (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands); a surrender.
G4274: From the alternate of protrecho; a runner ahead, i.e. Scout (figuratively, precursor).
G4276: to hope before, be the first to hope.
From pro and elpizo; to hope in advance of other confirmation.
G4277: to say previously, predict, proclaim, foretell.
From pro and epo; to say already, to predict.
forewarn, say (speak, tell) before. Compare proereo.
G4278: From pro and enarchomai; to commence already.
G4279: Middle voice from pro and epaggello; to promise of old.
G428: unfitted, unsuitable, inconvenient, not well placed.
From a (as a negative particle) and euthetos; not well set, i.e. Inconvenient.
G4280: From pro and ereo; used as alternate of proepo; to say already, predict.
G4281: to go forward, go on, advance; to go before, precede.
From pro and erchomai (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time).
go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.
G4282: to prepare or appoint beforehand, predestine.
From pro and hetoimazo; to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively).
G4283: to preach the gospel beforehand, foretell good tidings.
Middle voice from pro and euaggelizo; to announce glad news in advance.
G4284: trans: to hold before; mid: to excuse myself; intrans: to project, excel, surpass, have preeminence.
Middle voice from pro and echo; to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel.
G4285: to lead onward by example, go before, prefer.
From pro and hegeomai; to lead the way for others, i.e. Show deference.
G4286: a setting forth, the show-bread; predetermination, purpose.
From protithemai; a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God.
G4287: From pro and a derivative of tithemi; fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with hemera implied) a designated day.
G4288: forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.
G4289: From pro and thumos; forward in spirit, i.e. Predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity.
G429: to find by seeking out, discover.
From ana and heurisko; to find out.
G4290: readily, eagerly, with a ready mind, cheerfully.
G4291: to preside, rule over, give attention to, direct, maintain, practice diligently.
From pro and histemi; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise.
G4292: to provoke, stimulate, challenge, call out.
Middle voice from pro and kaleo; to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate.
G4293: From pro and kataggello; to anounce beforehand, i.e. Predict, promise.
G4294: From pro and katartizo; to prepare in advance.
G4295: to be set (placed, put) before, be already there.
From pro and keimai; to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward).
G4296: to announce or preach beforehand, announce by herald.
From pro and kerusso; to herald (i.e. Proclaim) in advance.
G4297: From prokopto; progress, i.e. Advancement (subjectively or objectively).
G4298: (originally of the pioneer cutting his way through brushwood), to advance, progress, make progress.
From pro and kopto; to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along).
increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.
G4299: From a compound of pro and krino; a prejudgment (prejudice), i.e. Prepossession.
G43: an arm, especially as bent to receive a burden.
From agkos (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved).
G430: to endure, bear with, have patience with, suffer, admit, persist.
Middle voice from ana and echo; to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with.
G4300: From pro and kuroo; to ratify previously.
G4301: to take before, anticipate; pass: to be caught or overtaken, taken by surprise.
From pro and lambano; to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise.
G4302: to tell (say) beforehand, forewarn, declare, tell plainly.
From pro and lego; to say beforehand, i.e. Predict, forewarn.
G4303: to predict, testify or protest beforehand.
From pro and marturomai; to be a witness in advance i.e. Predict.
G4304: to meditate beforehand, prepare, get up, premeditate.
From pro and meletao; to premeditate.
G4305: to be anxious beforehand, ponder beforehand.
From pro and merimnao; to care (anxiously) in advance.
G4306: to take thought for beforehand, provide for, practice.
From pro and noieo; to consider in advance, i.e. Look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself).
G4307: From pronoeo; forethought, i.e. Provident care or supply.
G4308: to see beforehand, foresee, see previously, be mindful of; mid: to pay regard to, set before me.
From pro and horao; to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view.
G4309: to foreordain, predetermine, mark out beforehand.
From pro and horizo; to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine.
G431: From a (as a particle of union) and an obsolete nepos (a brood); properly, akin, i.e. (specially) a cousin.
G4310: From pro and pascho; to undergo hardship previously.
G4311: to send forward, accompany, equip for a journey.
From pro and pempo; to send forward, i.e. Escort or aid in travel.
accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.
G4312: From a compound of pro and pipto; falling forward, i.e. Headlong (figuratively, precipitate).
G4313: to make to go before, to cause to go before.
From pro and poreuomai; to precede (as guide or herald).
G4314: advantageous for, at (denotes local proximity), toward (denotes motion toward a place).

A strengthened form of pro; a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. Toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. Pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. Near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or…
about, according to, against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you)…
G4315: From pro and sabbaton; a fore-sabbath, i.e. The Sabbath-eve.
day before the sabbath. Compare paraskeue.
G4316: to address by name, designate, accost.
From pros and a derivative of agora (mean to harangue); to address, i.e. Salute by name.
G4317: to bring to, bring near; to come to or towards, approach.
From pros and ago; to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach.
G4319: to beg, ask earnestly, ask for in addition.
From pros and aiteo; to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. Solicit.
G4320: to go up to, come up to, go up further.
From pros and anabaino; to ascend farther, i.e. Be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat).
G4321: From pros and analisko; to expend further.
G4322: to fill up by adding to, supply.
From pros and anapleroo; to fill up further, i.e. Furnish fully.
G4323: to lay on besides, to undertake besides (mid.).
From pros and anatithemai; to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult.
G4324: From pros and apeileo; to menace additionally.
G4325: From pros and dapanao; to expend additionally.
G4326: to want more, need in addition.
From pros and deomai; to require additionally, i.e. Want further.
G4327: (a) to await, expect, (b) to receive, welcome (originally: to house), (c) to accept.
From pros and dechomai; to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience).
G4328: to expect, wait for, await, think, anticipate.
From pros and dokeuo (to watch); to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await.
(be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for.
G4329: From prosdokao; apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated.
G433: From ana and heko; to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper.
G4330: to permit one to approach, permit further.
From pros and eao; to permit further progress.
G4331: From pros and eggizo; to approach near.
G4332: to wait upon, minister to, have charge of.
From a compound of pros and the base of hedraios; to sit near, i.e. Attend as a servant.
G4333: to work besides, to gain besides.
From pros and ergazomai; to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides.
G4334: to come up to, come to, come near (to), approach, consent (to).
From pros and erchomai (including its alternate); to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to.
(as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto).
G4335: (a) prayer (to God), (b) a place for prayer (used by Jews, perhaps where there was no synagogue).
From proseuchomai; prayer (worship); by implication, an oratory (chapel).
G4336: to pray, pray for, offer prayer.
From pros and euchomai; to pray to God, i.e. Supplicate, worship.
G4337: (a) to attend to, pay attention to, (b) to beware, be cautious, (c) to join, devote myself to.
From pros and echo; (figuratively) to hold the mind (nous implied) towards, i.e. Pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to.
(give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard.
G4338: to fasten with nails, nail to.
From pros and a derivative of helos; to peg to, i.e. Spike fast.
G4339: (lit: that has come to), a proselyte, that is a non-Jew, who has been circumcised and has adopted the Jews' religion.
From the alternate of proserchomai; an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte").
G434: From a (as a negative particle) and hemeros (lame); savage.
G4340: From pros and kairos; for the occasion only, i.e. Temporary.
dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal.
G4341: Middle voice from pros and kaleo; to call toward oneself, i.e. Summon, invite.
G4342: to persist, persevere in, continue steadfast in; to wait upon.

From pros and kartereo; to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor).
attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually).
G4344: Neuter of a presumed compound of pros and kephale; something for the head, i.e. A cushion.
G4345: to assign by lot, allot, associate with, follow as a disciple.
From pros and kleroo; to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with.
G4346: From a compound of pros and klino; a leaning towards, i.e. (figuratively) proclivity (favoritism).
G4347: (lit: to glue one thing to another), to join (unite) closely, cleave (to), follow as an adherent.
From pros and kollao; to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere.
G4348: a stumbling-block, an occasion for falling, a moral embarrassment.
From proskopto; a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy.
G4349: a cause of stumbling, offense, shock.
From proskopto; a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin.
G435: a male human being; a man, husband.
A primary word (compare anthropos); a man (properly as an individual male).
G4350: to stumble, strike the foot against, beat upon, take offense at.
From pros and kopto; to strike at, i.e. Surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. Trip up (literally or figuratively).
G4351: to roll to, roll up against.
From pros and kulioo; to roll towards, i.e. Block against.
G4352: to go down on knees to, do obeisance to, worship.

From pros and a probable derivative of kuon (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand); to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore).
G4354: From pros and laleo; to talk to, i.e. Converse with.
G4355: (a) to take to myself, (b) to take aside, (c) to welcome.
